name: sprc-slurm-mods
description: Claude Code mod for the sprc Slurm cluster: follows the jobs you submit and tells the agent once when they end (results, failures, right-sizing), job tools, a status line, and submit guardrails.

pollSeconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often to refresh cluster and job state from Slurm. Minimum 10.

wake.title: Wake the session when followed jobs end
wake.description: When the jobs a conversation followed have all ended and it is idle, start a turn with their results. Off: the results wait for your next prompt (a toast still shows).

guards.title: Submit guardrails
guards.description: enforce: block the few commands that would silently break or burden the login node (sbatch from node-local /tmp, GPU launchers on sprlab005); warn: let them run but tell the model; off: no checks. Jobs are followed either way.

liveContext.title: Live cluster context
liveContext.description: Attach a one-line cluster summary to prompts that mention jobs, GPUs or Slurm.
